feature_identifiability.near_collision_representation: per-node rooted summary: node_features plus incident symmetric_pair_features componentwise mean/std/max
feature_identifiability.normalization: train-only component mean and population standard deviation; constant components use scale 1
feature_identifiability.hard_contradiction_rule: only exact full rooted/local input equivalence with incompatible mapped nodal target, or proof that no common symmetric mapping exists

tangent_space.points: K0/K1/K2 x 3 historical seeds x initialization/selected
tangent_space.weighting: each complete graph contributes equally; node-vector MSE within graph; a0=400

family_shift.graph_summary: allowed node and symmetric edge features componentwise mean/std/min/max
family_shift.normalization: train graph-summary mean and population standard deviation; constant components use scale 1
family_shift.convex_hull_solver: SLSQP nonnegative weights summing to one

attribution_rules.A: STATIC_FITTING_FAILURE_ATTRIBUTED_OPTIMIZATION_CONDITIONING exactly under the five conditions frozen in the Stage 02M-R request
attribution_rules.B: STATIC_FITTING_FAILURE_ATTRIBUTED_FEATURE_IDENTIFIABILITY exactly under the conditions frozen in the Stage 02M-R request
attribution_rules.C: STATIC_FITTING_FAILURE_ATTRIBUTED_FUNCTION_CLASS_LIMIT exactly under the conditions frozen in the Stage 02M-R request
attribution_rules.D: STATIC_FITTING_FAILURE_ATTRIBUTED_SELECTION_OR_TRANSFER exactly under the conditions frozen in the Stage 02M-R request
attribution_rules.E: STATIC_FITTING_FAILURE_MIXED_OR_UNRESOLVED for simultaneous, contradictory, or non-orderable mechanisms
attribution_rules.F: STATIC_FITTING_FAILURE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE for unresolved provenance, mapping, hash, feature, or Jacobian evidence
